data_processing.2: Read counts per gene were summarized using HTSeq
data_processing.3: Genes with FPKM<1 in more than a half of the samples were excluded from the next steps
data_processing.5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: HTSeq files (.out) contains the count numbers sumarized per gene
